extracted.intended_audience: invited peer reviewers for Nature Communications (and other Nature journals offering these initiatives)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and policies for reviewers on Nature Communications' peer review initiatives, covering transparent peer review, reviewer recognition (naming), and co-reviewing with early career researchers. Applicable when preparing and submitting reviewer reports for manuscripts handled by the journal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transparent peer review
rubrics_metrics.description: When you accept the request to review for a journal that offers transparent peer review, of which Nature Communications is one, you agree to have your report published alongside the main paper.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Confidential reviewer comments to the editor or any other correspondence between authors and reviewers and our office will not be published. If you have reviewed a manuscript that is then transferred to a new journal that offers transparent peer review, your report at the previous journal will not be published even if the authors opt for transparent peer review; however, any further review that you undertake for the new journal might be published depending on the author choice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reviewer recognition (naming reviewers)
rubrics_metrics.description: Some journals offer reviewers the possibility of having their names added, in acknowledgement of their contribution. A reviewer will be asked during the review process whether they wish to be named or prefer to remain anonymous.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Where the journal also offers transparent peer review, we strongly encourage reviewers who wish to be named to also sign their reports. (See FAQ for further information.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Co-review with Early Career Researchers (ECRs)
rubrics_metrics.description: Nature Communications encourages invited reviewers to involve an early career researcher (ECR) in the peer review process. The co-reviewers compile a joint review that is submitted by the invited reviewer.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: An account is created for the ECR to ensure that they receive appropriate credit for their contribution. (See the editorial page and Early Career Researchers pathways section for more information.)
